title: sitekind
description: Title slide with tagline and hero image
speakerNotes:
- Introduce yourself and sitekind: the fully automated digital agency for local service businesses.
- One-liner: website, AI voice receptionist, and automated SEO — built and managed for the owner, from $150/mo.
- Set the frame: this is what an agency looks like when AI does the work — agency results at software prices.
- Keep it short (15–20 seconds); the story starts on the next slide.

title: The Problem
description: Local service businesses lose work they never see
speakerNotes:
- Paint the picture: a plumber or salon owner wins or loses on Google, but a real agency site starts at five figures and takes months.
- Missed calls = missed revenue: owners are on the job, not by the phone — every unanswered call books with the next result on the list.
- DIY tools don't fix it: SEO, content, ads, and reviews demand weekly attention; they hand owners a second job.
- Key takeaway: this work is essential, but no one is positioned to do it for them at a price they can afford.

title: The Solution
description: An entire agency, run by automation
speakerNotes:
- The answer: an entire agency, run by automation — not another tool the owner has to learn.
- sitekind generates a complete, conversion-optimized website from the business's real data, then keeps phones answered and rankings climbing.
- Hit the three proof points: live in 24 hours, from $150/mo (a fraction of agency retainers), zero effort for the owner.
- Emphasize 'for the owner, not by the owner' — that's the wedge against DIY builders.

title: How It Works
description: Preview first, pay later — three steps
speakerNotes:
- Lead with the model: preview first, pay later — we build the site before the owner buys.
- Step 1: we pull the Google Business Profile (photos, reviews, hours, services) and generate the full site with zero forms.
- Step 2: a 24/7 AI voice agent answers calls, books appointments, and texts back missed calls within 30 seconds.
- Step 3: weekly SEO content and Google Maps optimization push rankings up on autopilot.
- Note the sales insight: showing a finished site removes almost all buying friction.

title: The Product
speakerNotes:
- Four AI systems on one platform — each replaces a role an agency would bill for.
- Website generation: 10–15 page conversion-optimized site written from real business data, live in 24 hours.
- Voice receptionist: answers every call, books appointments, texts back the ones it misses — never sleeps.
- Automated SEO & content: weekly posts and pages, AI-written and quality-judged before publishing.
- Google Maps dominance: citations, reviews, and local signals managed continuously, with a Top-3 Maps guarantee on the flagship plan.

title: The Client Experience
speakerNotes:
- The sale starts with a finished preview, not a proposal: owners type their business name and see their own completed website.
- After launch, everything lives in one client portal — calls, bookings, content, rankings, plus monthly performance reports.
- Ownership, not lock-in: clients own their website outright and can cancel the low annual maintenance anytime.
- Point out that ownership builds trust and is a deliberate contrast to agencies and DIY platforms that hold sites hostage.

title: The Market
description: Positioned between DIY tools and traditional agencies
speakerNotes:
- Walk the spectrum: traditional agencies ($10k+, months of lead time), freelancers (one person, no ongoing SEO or phones), DIY builders (cheap, but the website becomes the owner's second job).
- sitekind sits in the open middle: agency-grade output at software prices, from $150/mo — because AI does the work.
- The gap exists because agency economics required humans; automation collapses that cost structure.
- Optional add: millions of local service businesses in the US alone sit in this underserved middle.

title: Pricing
speakerNotes:
- Four plans, one upgrade path — customers enter cheap and grow into bigger packages.
- Starter, $150/mo: AI-built 5–8 page site, hosted, secured, maintained — the low-friction entry point.
- Core Agency, $5,000 first year then $1,500/yr (financeable at $375/mo): premium site plus weekly SEO, ads setup, citations.
- AI Voice Add-on, $3,500/yr: 24/7 receptionist, missed-call text-back, chatbot, call analytics.
- Mega Package, $15,000: 20-week campaign with a Top-3 Google Maps guarantee — or we keep working free. The guarantee closes deals.

title: Traction
speakerNotes:
- Let the numbers land, then add one line of color each.
- $5.4M+ revenue generated across portfolio brands — the playbook already works.
- 24 hours from signup to live website — the speed claim is real, not aspirational.
- 91.7% payment success rate — customers pay and stay.
- 90% cheaper than a human receptionist — the AI voice agent's unit economics in one line.

title: The Vision
speakerNotes:
- Zoom out: millions of main-street businesses still run on word of mouth and a Facebook page.
- The vision: give each of them the website, phones, and rankings of a company ten times their size — automatically.
- Close with confidence, then make the ask (investment, partnership, or intro) and point to sitekind.ai.
- Pause for questions — pricing and traction slides usually draw the most follow-ups.
